text: Anselm Reyes has been named the new conductor of the Halewyn Philharmonic, the orchestra said Tuesday after a vote by its board in Northgate. Reyes, 42, will begin leading the ensemble in September, replacing interim conductor Mara Velin. The appointment follows a six-month search that drew 18 applicants from six countries, according to the orchestra. Reyes is currently associate conductor of the Lydmere Civic Symphony and has previously led youth ensembles in Belcourt and Soren Vale. He will make his Halewyn debut at the season-opening concert on Sept. 14 at Kestrel Hall. “We wanted a conductor with precision, warmth and local commitment, and Anselm Reyes brings all three,” said board chair Lina Ortez.
